title: Daejeon Hoetong (Comprehensive Collection of the Great Codes, 1865), Book of Rites: succession, adoption, marriage, mourning
title_original: 大典會通 禮典 (대전회통 예전): 奉祀 · 立後 · 婚嫁 · 五服 · 喪葬
author: Jo Du-sun 趙斗淳 et al. (compilers)
license: public domain (statute of 1865); original-text transcription from 국사편찬위원회 한국사데이터베이스 (modern translation not used)
notes: Final Joseon codification, layering the 經國大典 (〔原〕 1485), 續大典 (〔續〕 1746), 大典通編 (〔增〕 1785) and 大典會通 (〔補〕 1865) rules; shows how the law of heir adoption (立後: 禮曹 立案, 罷繼歸宗, penalties for private adoption) and ritual succession developed after 1485. Small-character notes in （ ）; collation notes omitted; tables flattened as in the 經國大典 file.

title: Dongmong Seonseup (First Learning for Children), with 口訣 and Korean 언해
author: Bak Se-mu 朴世茂
date_of_work: c. 1541–1543 (composition, conventionally dated); later 언해 editions
notes: Original classical Chinese with interlinear Korean particles (口訣/현토) run into the text; the ruby readings of the Wikisource transcription are dropped. Each Chinese passage is followed by its Korean 언해 paragraph; glosses inside the 언해 are in （ ）. 總論 (history of China and Korea), the royal preface and Song Si-yeol's afterword are in plain 현토 form. Wikisource marks the page as a stub (토막글) but all five relations, 總論, preface and afterword are present.
